settled_stitch.note: Palette frozen at 196. Style rasters still cover only the accepted core. EYNWS4 folded in (typ tx=-48..-17 x typ ty=128..135; 8 m -6..-3 x 16). Window x=-34816..30720, y=-19456..28672 is a bounding box (not expanded); settled tiles are non-rectangular. 1 m columns (typ tx: typ ty): -272..-241: -96..63; -240..-49: -152..63; -48..-17: -152..63, 128..223; -16..79: -152..223; 80..143: -56..223; 144..239: -56..63. 8 m: -34..-31: -12..7; -30..-7: -19..7; -6..-3: -19..7, 16..27; -2..9: -19..27; 10..17: -7..27; 18..29: -7..7. No tiles invented in the remaining gaps. In progress, not ingested: EYNWS5 (typ tx=-48..-17 x typ ty=120..127; 8 m -6..-3 x typ ty=15) and WDW (typ tx=-280..-273 x typ ty=-88..-57; 8 m typ tx=-35 x typ ty=-11..-8), the latter outside the current window (west of typ tx=-272). Full-window ground_all / foliage.bin deferred. Dev server pid 438670 serves /data/* from disk (missing -> 404).

raster_chunks.note: 1 m rasters split into CS×CS chunks (≤8192) for WebGL; layer = cy*nx+cx. These style maps still cover only the accepted core window x=-2048..10240, y=-7168..8192. The streamed tile window is larger; the viewer samples rasters/foliage.bin/terrain.bin from this origin (uMap0 / uRasSize). Full-window rasters would exceed WebGL 8192 and box memory.
